strings.support_methods_subtitle: Fren tarrayt n usnerni i tḥemmleḍ. Yal tukci tettḥadar srid iḍebsiyen, asenqed, d tɣawsiwin n ujerred.
strings.support_story_1_body: Innioasis tessuffuɣ-d s lqedd iferdisen imaynuten i yimariren am Y1 (s yiswi n tmuɣliwin n tfelwit yeffren am 6.0, 7.0, d 8.0) i yettqerriben s tsusmi i wallalen iqburen. Ayen ixussen, adeg-nsen n Internet yettak-d zero n tmuɣliwin d zero n unekcum ɣer yiferdisen n tmeẓdit (firmwares) ay ixeddmen yagi akken ad d-sfaydin seg yiwen n lḥal n tmeẓdit. Amsmayni d usenfar n Community Firmware ttnadin iḥricen: nessemras yal ROM n tmeẓdit n tmeẓdit, nessekcam s wudem awurman asenqed n tmeẓdit-ik, yerna nettaǧǧa amyurar-ik ad yettwaxdem s laman.
strings.support_story_1_headline: Mi ara tkemlen yimseftiyen, tettnerni tmetti.
strings.support_story_1_item_1: Asellek n Yimurar Iqersen: Iḍrisen n tɣellist ttḍemmiren dakken isemtar imaynuten ur ttbeddilen ara aselkim aqbur.
strings.support_story_1_item_2: ROMs n Stock Archived: Asemres n tmeẓdiyin n luzin n Innioasis yettwasfeḍ.
strings.support_story_1_item_3: Taɣerɣert n tmeẓdit taɣelnawt: Allalen n tmeẓdit ikemlen i macOS, Linux, d Windows am wakken.
strings.support_story_1_item_4: Hardware Intelligence: Asekcem n tfelwit s wudem awurman akken ad d-tafeḍ dima aferdis iwatan.
strings.support_story_1_lead: Aḥareb ɣef wallal-ik seg tmeẓdiyin n tmeẓdiyin tisusmiwin d tmuɣliwin yettwaqerḍen.
strings.support_story_2_body: Ad tḍefren aselkim unṣib n Innioasis s umata anamek-is d asekcem n yisental n usmel n Google Drive iɛeddan, tiferkiwin n useyyer n Baidu yemmuten, d yifuyla zip n lbaḍna war allalen n tmeẓẓuɣt. Nebna aẓeḍḍa n usmel yettwasnen, ilelli s tɣellist SHA-256 yettwasqedcen, isalan n usnefli, d usmel yettwasneflen s tɣawla. Tiwsiwin-ik srid ttḥerriqent tiɣriwin d usmel i d-yettaǧǧan aya ad yili 24 n tsaɛtin deg wass, 365 n wussan deg useggas.
strings.support_story_2_headline: Ulac iḍebsiyen n Google i iɛerḍen. Ulac axeddim n uxemmem. Aselkim ameẓyan ixeddem kan.
strings.support_story_2_item_1: Direct High-Speed ​​CDN: Asekcem s tɣawla, usrid war tilisa n usekcem neɣ assaɣen yemmuten.
strings.support_story_2_item_2: Ssnefli Ibeddilen: Ttwaɛeqleḍ deg lawan ideg ara d-ffɣen yisuḍaf imaynuten n tmetti neɣ ad d-ɣlin yisuḍaf.
strings.support_story_2_item_3: Installs s tɣawla s tɣawla: Iḍrisen n tmuɣli ibanen ad k-id-ssiwḍen deg yal aḍfar n tmeẓdit.
strings.support_story_2_item_4: Tametti n tutlayin yemgaraden: Tettwassen s lekmal-is s teglizit, tacinwat, talmanit, taspenyulit, tafransist & tajapunit.
strings.support_story_2_lead: Infrastructure n tmetti s tɣawla, yettwasqedcen i tzemreḍ ad t-tḍemneḍ s tidet.
strings.support_story_3_body: Aselkim n luzin n usmel yettḥezzib kan ɣef wayen izemren ad t-yexdem usmel-ik Y1 neɣ Y2. Tametti-nneɣ tessekcem-d Rockbox, inagrawen n uxeddim n tmeẓdit ifesden, aẓawan n tmeẓdit n usliḍ, d yisental n tmeẓdit ɣer tudert. Nesɣa imgerraden n tɣawsiwin n tfekka s tɣawla akken ad njerred, ad nbeddel ajenyuṛ, yerna ad nessekcem yal asras. Tadukli n Amsmayni tettḥadar srid tiferkiwin-a n ukayad yerna tessemɣaray asnerni n useɣzan ameẓyan s tɣawla.
strings.support_story_3_headline: Asekcem n tzemmar n umyurar-ik n Innioasis.
strings.support_story_3_item_1: Rockbox n yiwen n uḍris: Aẓawan n Audiophile d yisental n usmel yettwasbedden deg tesdidin.
strings.support_story_3_item_2: Aselkim n tmetti: Asnerni n tbatrit, UI zeddigen, d tallelt n uḍris n usliḍ atrar.
strings.support_story_3_item_3: Active Hardware Lab: Nettjerriḍ ɣef yifarisen n tfekka n tidet uqbel ad d-nessuffeɣ kra n lebni.
strings.support_story_3_item_4: Zero Bloatware: 100% d ilelli, d aselkim amezwaru n tɣellist war ma yella-d usmel neɣ aḍfar.
strings.support_story_3_lead: Aggay n Rockbox, inagrawen n uxeddim ifesden s tɣawla, d tlelli n yimesliyen.
strings.support_story_4_body: Mi ara tkemmel tkebbanit n tɣawsiwin n tɣawsiwin s tɣawsiwin-nsen ay d-iteddun, ttwaɛezlen yimukan iqburen. Innioasis ur yettak ara aɛiwen n Linux, ur yettak ara iḍrisen n ubeddel ifazen, yerna ur yettak ara abrid s wacu ara d-terreḍ mi ara yeɣli usras. Amsmayni yella acku iseqdacen n tḥemla ur yessefk ara ad sneqsen aẓawan yelhan s lekmal-is. 100% n ttawilat n tmetti ttṛuḥun srid ɣer uḥraz n wallal-a yeldin i yal yiwen.
strings.support_story_4_headline: Ɛiwen-aɣ ad nexdem ayen ur xeddmen ara Innioasis.
strings.support_story_4_item_1: Rescue & Unbrick: Asenqes yettwasnen yettkemmil ula ma ugin wallalen ad bdun.
strings.support_story_4_item_2: Tallalt n Linux n Tmezgunt Tamezwarut: Taɛiwen s lekmal-is MediaTek yettfeggiḍen deg tferkiwin n Linux.
strings.support_story_4_item_3: Transparent Changelogs: Tiɣriwin n uslelli s tɣawla akken ad tessneḍ akken iwata d acu i yettbeddilen.
strings.support_story_4_item_4: 100% s tedrimt n tmetti: Yal lqahwa tettaǧǧa archive yeldi yerna d ilelli i yal yiwen.
strings.support_story_4_lead: Aḥareb n useɣzan amecṭuḥ s tezmert n tmetti yettaṭṭafen allalen-ik seg yimukan n tmes.
